text: This report fulfills TTC Board direction from January 27, 2025, to report back on the Greenwood Shop paint booth replacement project. This undertaking aligns with TTC Corporate Plan Action 3.1.3, Leverage Line 2 Modernization to Enhance Line 2 Capacity Long-Term and the TTC’s Innovation and Sustainability Strategy.

The TTC Board: 1. Approved the recommendation contained in Confidential Attachment 1 and authorized the information in Confidential Attachment 1 to remain confidential until the contract change has been issued to the contractor.
